hint.ADD-02: Start at the bigger number and count on.
hint.ADD-03: How many more make 10? Count the empty spaces.
hint.ADD-04: Make 10 first, then add the rest.
hint.ADD-05: Add the ones, then add the tens.
hint.ADD-06: Add the ones. If you get 10 or more, trade 10 ones for 1 ten.
hint.ADD-07: Start with the ones column. Carry when a column makes 10 or more.
hint.SUB-01: Start with all of them and take some away.
hint.SUB-02: Start at the bigger number and count back.
hint.SUB-03: Think addition: what joins the part to make the whole?
hint.SUB-04: Go back to 10 first, then take away the rest.
hint.SUB-05: Take away the ones, then take away the tens.
hint.SUB-06: Not enough ones? Trade 1 ten for 10 ones first.
hint.SUB-07: Start with the ones. If you need to, borrow from the next column.
hint.MUL-01: Count the groups and how many are in each. Skip count!
hint.MUL-02: Count the rows, then how many in each row.
hint.MUL-03: Times 0 is 0. Times 1 stays the same. Times 10: add a zero.
hint.MUL-04: Times 4 is double, then double again.
hint.MUL-05: Times 6 is times 5, plus one more group.
hint.MUL-06: Times 9 is times 10, take away one group.
hint.DIV-01: Share one at a time until none are left.
hint.DIV-02: How many groups can we make?
hint.DIV-03: Think: what times the number makes the total?
